hypothesis.statement: Periodic public metaAndAssetCtxs snapshots can supplement update-driven activeAssetCtx messages and keep future SP500/SPCX mark-risk evidence below the frozen five-second maximum gap.
hypothesis.why_now: The corrected v51 lifecycle tool reproduced all eight prospective index onsets but could not evaluate any lifecycle because mark capture began after the eligible signals.

historical_falsification.conclusion: The historical lifecycles remain technically censored; no synthetic prices or relaxed evidence threshold are permitted.

capture_contract.timestamp_semantics: local receipt after the unsigned public response returns

continuous_capture.next_experiment: Evaluate the next attributable eligible SP500/SPCX onset through its complete v51 stop, 100/40/80 profit-lock, or 24-hour fallback lifecycle.

risks_and_falsifiers: Any receipt gap above 5000ms overlapping an open lifecycle keeps that lifecycle unresolved.
A malformed, ambiguous, or position-misaligned metadata/context response aborts capture.
A stale status file or stopped sampler means future path completeness must not be assumed.
A venue rate-limit or transport failure can create an evidence gap but cannot affect live orders.
Source identity, local receipt semantics, or archive hash changes invalidate prior evidence.
